## Responsible use of data {.unnumbered}

The examples use open datasets on road-traffic accidents and epidemiological records, among other sources. The models, graphics, and interpretations are academic exercises prepared by the author and do not constitute official results from the institutions that provide the data.

The COVID-19 examples are strictly educational. They are not diagnostic instruments, clinical-prognosis tools, or direct support for medical decision-making.
